MREIDOLON.Setting.LangHint: Which language EIDOLON and its direction bar are imported in. “Automatic” follows Foundry’s language.
MREIDOLON.OnlyGM: EIDOLON: only the Warden can do this.
MREIDOLON.NoPack: EIDOLON: the adventure compendium is missing.
MREIDOLON.ImportOverwrite: This world already has content. Importing overwrites any adventure documents you changed; pregens your players already use are left untouched.
MREIDOLON.Imported: EIDOLON imported. Start with the journal “I · Before Docking” and open the MR- Dirección bar.
MREIDOLON.UpdatedText: A new version of the adventure is available ({antes} → {ahora}). Reimport it now? Adventure documents you changed will be overwritten; your players’ pregens are left untouched.
MREIDOLON.NeedDireccion: EIDOLON: enable the “MR- Dirección” module to get the Warden’s bar (scenes, music, effects and clocks).
MREIDOLON.LogHint: Record each person’s Imprint (0–3) and mark who is already a copy. The draw follows chapter 03: one slip at Imprint 2, two slips at Imprint 3.
MREIDOLON.CondTitle: To draw, all four conditions must hold at once
MREIDOLON.Cond1: Imprint 2 or 3: the latent matrix has formed.
MREIDOLON.Cond2: A physical source nearby: 09, 11, 15, or a copy in contact with moisture.
MREIDOLON.Cond4: A tissue matrix prepared for that person.
MREIDOLON.NoReplacement: One of the four conditions is missing: no replacement.
MREIDOLON.Limit: There are already three active copies on the station (including the first): no replacement.
MREIDOLON.NoEligible: No one is at Imprint 2 or 3: no replacement.
MREIDOLON.Replaced: is now a copy (drawn from {n} slips).
MREIDOLON.WriteDown: Write the time, the room, and one piece of physical evidence in the Log: a filament, a pressure change, or microscopic growth. No more than one replacement every 30 minutes of fiction.
MREIDOLON.NoPeople: EIDOLON: import the adventure to get the crew and the survivors.
